verdict.rationale: Airwallex supports Global Accounts for receiving funds in multiple currencies and Transfers/Batch Transfers for moving money out, but there is no documented feature for opening multiple 'checking sub-accounts' under one entity nor any auto-allocation/rules engine that splits incoming deposits across sub-accounts. missing for 10: explicit sub-account creation/management API, deposit-splitting or auto-allocation rules, finance-lead workflow documentation, and any independent confirmation of this specific capability.
